title: 3 · Recolorable render (shader archive)
intro: Keeps the pre-color data in a compressed browser archive. The current palettes and materials are applied on playback and on every video export: one computation, as many colorings as you like.

status.converting: Converting the folder to an archive

errors.noDirectoryPicker: This browser cannot pick a local folder
errors.noFilePicker: This browser cannot pick a file
errors.savingUnavailableUseBrowser: Direct saving to disk unavailable: use the browser storage

create.summary: Create from the settings of section 1
create.estimate: Raw source: {gb} GB · {blocks} blocks · center covered over 17 octaves. Measured compression ≈ 4 to 5×; constant fields and uniform blocks are not stored.

archives.quota: Browser storage: {used} GB used of {total} GB available
archives.empty: No archive. Create one above or import a .smexp file.

source.completeFirst: Complete this archive in the ExpMap panel before creating a video.

playback.budgetHint: Extra budget on top of the open engine. The cache subdivides if whole octaves do not fit.

video.hdrHint: Rec.2020 / PQ · full frame-by-frame rendering, mono or stereo. The 10-bit encoder is checked at startup, with no SDR fallback. Preview remains SDR. Compression follows the selected profile.
video.budgetInsufficient: Insufficient budget: reduce the resolution or increase the player budget.
video.eyesTopBottom: Left eye on top, right eye at the bottom.
video.eyesSideBySide: Left eye on the left, right eye on the right.
video.stereoHint: {eyes} The file keeps the chosen resolution; select {layout} in the player to restore the proportions. Analytic height and reflections specific to each eye. Slight common crop to cover the edges.
video.stereoCost: Frame-by-frame render, slower and more memory-hungry. Material reliefs remain lighting details.
video.stereoBudgetInsufficient: Insufficient budget for stereo: reduce the resolution or increase the player budget.
video.ringDirect: One ring fits in the budget: direct encoding, without an intermediate file.
video.ringEstimate: {passes} passes · up to {octaves} useful octave(s) each, depending on the budget (+2 reserved) · intermediates ≈ {gb} GB of video at the target bitrate, excluding compressed masks and containers.
video.ringBudgetInsufficient: Insufficient budget for the intermediates and the cache.
video.ringDetail: One MP4 per ring, with the chosen codec and a reduced bitrate for small rings. Losslessly compressed AA masks. Color goes through the video compression, then the final encoding. Finished rings are resumed; the interrupted ring and the final assembly start over.

finalizing: The part already rendered is being finalized.
